name: Ahwa: Pureun Darui Ma-eum
source:
Whenever Ahwa’s heart wavers, rain falls.

You are fated to stand alone. Will you accept that fate? Or will you defy it?

Born to an Azure Dragon and a Green Dragon, Ahwa is a colorless dragon. When her mother dies, she succeeds her as Changcheon, head of the Azure Dragon Clan.

But with that title comes a duty. The head of the clan must stand alone and carry the weight of the entire clan.

Can Ahwa open her heart to someone and find a way to be with him?

Ahwa: Heart of the Azure Dragon is an otome visual novel set in a world home to four guardian clans: the Azure Dragon, White Tiger, Vermilion Bird, and Black Tortoise.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5458050/Ahwa_Heart_of_the_Azure_Dragon/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
每当雅华心绪动摇之时，天便会落雨。

你注定要孤身一人。你会顺从这份宿命，还是起身抗争？

身为青龙与绿龙所生之女，雅华是一条无色之龙。母亲逝世后，她继任为青龙族首领“苍天”。

然而与这一名号相伴而来的，还有沉重的使命——一族之长必须孤身而立，独自背负起整个氏族的重担。

雅华能否向某个人敞开心扉，找到与他相守的道路？

《雅华：苍月之心》是一部以青龙、白虎、朱雀、玄武四大守护神族共存的世界为舞台的乙女视觉小说。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5458050/Ahwa_Heart_of_the_Azure_Dragon/]Steam[/url]]
